name: Kashino Zakuro
source:
"Thank you for your invitation."

The heroine. She tries her best to be a normal girl. 
She devotes herself to the role of a calm, considerate, and ordinary girl.
Still, traces of sorrow can be seen lurking beneath her smiles.
